short-description: Showcase website for a real estate agency in Briançon, with a property catalogue, online valuation, and lead capture.
description: Next.js website built for IMMOBILIER BRIANÇON Géraldine JULLIEN, a real estate agency in the French Alps, combining a synced property catalogue, a free online valuation form, and several lead capture paths.
long-description:
IMMOBILIER BRIANÇON Géraldine JULLIEN has been selling property in Briançon, Serre Chevalier, and Montgenèvre since 1993. The agency needed a website that matched the quality of its listings: professional photography, 360° virtual tours, drone footage, 2D and 3D floor plans, and virtual staging are at the heart of its sales pitch, so the site had to show that work rather than describe it.

We built the site with Next.js and Tailwind CSS on the App Router. The property catalogue is served by internal API routes that read from the agency's real estate software, so the sales team keeps publishing from the tool it already uses and the website stays in sync without a second back office. A separate route aggregates the agency's Google reviews, displayed on the homepage with the overall rating.

Several paths lead to a conversation with an agent: a free online pre-valuation form, an e-mail alert for new listings, a newsletter, a referral programme for business introducers, and a contact page with a map. Metadata, Open Graph tags, and a dynamic sitemap cover the local search queries the agency competes on.

The site was delivered and handed over to the agency, which has since moved its public website to a no-code platform it can edit without a developer.

challenges.listings-sync: Keeping the catalogue in sync with the agency's real estate software so the sales team only publishes once
challenges.local-seo: Competing on local search for Briançon, Serre Chevalier, and Montgenèvre against national property portals
challenges.valuation-funnel: Designing a valuation form short enough to be filled in, honest enough to send sellers to a real expert
challenges.media-heavy-content: Serving photography, virtual tours, and video without wrecking load times on mountain mobile connections
challenges.strict-csp: Running a strict Content Security Policy while embedding third-party media and listing data
challenges.mountain-market-positioning: Addressing both year-round residents and second-home buyers on the same pages

learnings.local-seo-wins: A local agency wins on neighbourhood and resort queries, not on generic property searches
learnings.third-party-data-dependency: When listings come from an external tool, every failure mode of that tool becomes a failure mode of the site
learnings.lead-capture-paths: Sellers and buyers convert on different pages, so each needs its own call to action
learnings.content-ownership: Clients who produce their own photos and videos need a way to publish them without a deployment
learnings.performance-with-media: Image formats and lazy loading do more for a media-heavy site than any other optimisation
